admission.justification: Prevents silently spending an obsolete hard-coded review budget, losing recorded allowance history or admitting a record-only/wording claim beyond its actual boundary.

applicability: Task review begin and public review-state answers for the ordinary CODE sequence and separately counted MEMORY lane.
conditions: Live settings are resolved for begin; a newly admitted round recomputes the effective limit, while approved extras remain cumulative.
A valid begin replay while pending is idempotent and keeps the already-recorded round and limit.
exclusions: No reset of count, sealed findings or lane identity.
No promise that arbitrary non-review task mutations re-read settings.
Per-call settings resolution is not a promise of limit recomputation/persistence on pending replay.
statement: begin_review recomputes and persists the task limit from the settings number plus approved extra rounds for each newly begun round, and supported answers carry that limit. A replay while that round is pending returns the unchanged document; it does not recompute or persist a replacement limit.
